subject.title: San Jose Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 4

text: Mary Grunthaner is a retired educator. In that capacity for more than three decades, the issues of ensuring safety and mental health support for students and staff, accountability for those in leadership positions, and academic progress for all students in San Jose Unified have been at the forefront of Mary Grunthaner's professional career. Those issues will be the focus of her time after her being elected as Trustee for Area 4 of San Jose Unified.

Mary's safety and mental health priorities are to support and expand Wellness Centers throughout the district, to ensure positive transitions at consolidated elementary schools, and protect the right of all students to be safe from bullying, especially LGBTQ+ students.
Mary's accountability priorities are to provide transparency in decision-making, to engage in open communication with families and community members, and to hold district leadership accountable.

Mary's progress priorities are to support high-quality public education, student achievement at the highest levels, and to ensure access to academic counselors and instructional coaches at each school site.

Recently, San Jose Unified's community has been impacted by the closure of five elementary schools, nearly 19% of all district elementary schools. As Trustee, Mary will diligently work to support students, families, and staff who have had to make this transition. Mary looks forward to continuing her life's work of public service as trustee.

Mary Grunthaner earned her Bachelor's degree in History and Social Science Teacher Prep from Humboldt State University (HSU) in 1991, her Teaching Credential from HSU in 1992, and her Master's degree in Educational Leadership from San Jose State University in 2002. With 25 years experience as a classroom teacher and 7 years as an Assistant Principal in San Jose Unified, she retired in 2024. Mary has been married to her wife Sheri for 18 years and enjoys spending time with their three grandchildren.

As a Social Studies Teacher at San Jose High School and John Muir Middle School, Mary invested her energy in helping her students recognize that they are part of the story of the United States of America through civic engagement. As an Assistant Principal at Willow Glen High School, Mary utilized her Master's degree in Educational Leadership in helping students from varied backgrounds to achieve their goals and collaborating with teachers to enhance their teaching.
For more information, visit Mary Grunthaner's campaign website: Grunthaner4SanJoseSchools.com

text: I am a parent, community leader, and former San José Unified School District Trustee who understands our schools and how to get results. I will focus on student success, accountability, and responsible budgeting. As a parent of two students at Pioneer High School, I continue to be deeply invested in our district's future and am ready to serve again. I ask for your vote because Our Students Deserve The Best.

For more than a decade, I have supported our schools as a PTA member, School Site Council secretary, and President of the Pioneer High School Education Foundation. I have volunteered as a youth sports coach and adult literacy tutor. As the chair of the Citizens Bond Oversight Committee, I worked to ensure transparency and strong stewardship of public funds. On the San José Library and Early Education Commission, I helped connect every student to a library card, expanding access to learning. Professionally, I bring over 20 years of experience as a data scientist at Apple, where I analyze budgets, measure outcomes, and deliver results.
My focus and priorities will be as follows:
Helping every student succeed. Set clear academic goals, expand early literacy and math support, and ensure teachers have the tools they need.
Supporting safe, healthy schools. Partner with families and staff to improve safety, support student well-being, and promote responsible technology use.

Ensuring transparency and accountability. Expand access to Board meetings, provide clear updates on student progress and Measure R spending, and require meaningful community input before major decisions.

I believe strong schools build strong communities. I am committed to honest leadership, open communication, and real results for students and families. I would be honored to earn your vote. Our Students Deserve The Best! Learn more at melilloforsjusd.com or email me at michael@melilloforsjusd.com.
